By revoking governor role of old Timelock (0x7D80c9422Bcb6809DEd28acD9916d647caFd484f), Ring Dao becomes the only governor of Few Factory (0x455b20131D59f01d082df1225154fDA813E8CeE9).

# Introducing Duo Exchange
Ring Dao is proposing a simple but novel interest rate swap protocol, called Duo Exchange ([<u>https://duo.exchange</u>](https://duo.exchange)). This protocol allows LPs to access (1) fixed rate yield until maturity and (2) variable but potentially higher yield compared to the yield source.



Blast brought WETH and USDB with native yield. Particle and Ring witnessed the urge to lock a fixed interest rate upfront. Also, liquidity providers are looking for a safe way to generate higher return, while keeping the principal intact at all times.



This protocol is tailored specifically for the yield management need, with these features:

\- LP with single sided token

\- No impermanent loss

\- No lock up, withdraw any time

\- No risk on the principal



With this simple protocol, it unlocks a wide range of product offerings:

\- Buy Now Get Later (with discount)

\- Lock in fixed interest rate

\- LP to earn higher rate over time

\- Manage liquidity positions



This protocol is co-developed with the Particle team ([<u>https://particle.trade</u>](https://particle.trade)), which is also a Blast Big Bang competition winner.



Technical documentation and audit reports can be accessed at [<u>https://particle-1.gitbook.io/duo</u>](https://particle-1.gitbook.io/duo).



In order to manage yield, Duo Exchange’s Yield Manager module needs to have the minter and burner access from Few Wrapped Token. In the contract design, Yield Manager has a clear spend limit that will not exceed a capped yield rate. Also, timelock revokes Yield Manager’s governor role (left it with a guardian role) for maximum security measure.

Here are actions this proposal need to take:

1. Few Factory Core grants **minter** to Yield Manager (for WETH)
2. Few Factory Core grants **minter** to Yield Manager (for USDB)
3. Few Factory Core grants **burner** to Yield Manager (for WETH)
4. Few Factory Core grants **burner** to Yield Manager (for USDB)
5. WETH Yield Manager Core **revokes** Multisig’s **governor role**
6. USDB Yield Manager Core **revokes** Multisig’s **governor role**

# Introducing Ring Launchpad
Ring Dao is launching Ring Launchpad. The launchpad allows users to launch tokens on Blast permissionlessly.



In order to provide liquidity for launched tokens, Ring Launchpad needs to have the minter access from Few Wrapped Token.



Here is the action this proposal need to take:

Few Factory Core grants minter to Ring Lauchpad (0x8814a2AA2384d65672C7dC0650454E56F62fBA8B).
